# Amazon Linux 2027 RPM packages as of the 2027.0.20260903 release
<a name="all-packages-AL2027"></a>

The following list includes all packages for Amazon Linux 2027 release [2027.0.20260903](relnotes-2027.0.20260903.md).

## All AL2027 packages
<a name="AL2027"></a>

Each AL2027 major version receives 5 years of long-term support. Some packages closely follow their upstream release cadence and support model, and thus have an earlier end of life. For details, see [Package support information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2027/release-notes/support-information.html)

For more information about support for major versions of AL2027, see [AL2027 release cadence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2027/ug/release-cadence.html).

<a name="list-packages"></a>
